capabilities: Run semantic, multilingual search over vault notes
Expose active file, cursor position, and selection to agents
Create, read, edit, move, and delete notes via MCP tools
Patch note metadata and refresh the semantic index
Fall back to direct file read/write when Obsidian is closed
disambiguation: Not an in-app AI assistant; it exposes MCP tools to external clients like Claude Desktop, which do the actual agent work.
extras: Install is manual (copy dist/plugin-release into the plugins folder). The semantic model (~110MB) and vector index are stored inside the vault at .obsidian/plugins/companion-mcp/. Without an MCP client configured, the plugin alone does little.
intentEvidence: A hybrid Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem for Obsidian, providing vault-wide semantic intelligence and real-time editor context awareness.
problem: AI agents have no structured access to Obsidian's vault or live editor context, and Obsidian search is keyword-based rather than semantic.

relations.evidence: Add the following to your claude_desktop_config.json

requires.name: MCP client such as Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex, or Gemini CLI
Node.js >= 20 with the companion MCP npm package

summary: MCP plugin plus Node.js server that lets external AI agents semantically search the vault, read editor state, and edit notes via structured tools.
